meta.title: BOBR
meta.description: Diet catering, delivered — keto, gluten-free, and for allergies.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to see your diet and your orders.
auth.registerSubtitle: An account is what lets us build a diet around you.
auth.errorTaken: An account with that address already exists.
auth.errorGeneric: That did not work. Please try again.

order.leadTime: The earliest delivery is the day after tomorrow — the kitchen needs notice. You can pick days up to the end of next month.
order.minDays: A calendar order needs at least 5 days.
order.ladder: Discounts: 10 days — 10% · 20 days — 15% · a whole month — 20%
order.totalNote: The total is calculated by the server when you place the order.
order.successBody: Cash on delivery. You will find the details in your dashboard.
order.errorGeneric: That order could not be placed.
order.shippingByZone: Delivery cost depends on the zone — enter your postal code below.
order.addressLineRequired: Enter the street and number (at least 3 characters).
order.addressLineTooLong: The address can be at most {max} characters.
order.cityRequired: Enter the town or city (at least 2 characters).
order.cityTooLong: The town name can be at most {max} characters.
order.zoneChecking: Checking whether we deliver to this code…
order.zoneNotDelivered: We do not deliver to this postal code.
order.zoneFailed: The delivery zone could not be checked. Delivery is calculated when the order is placed.

consultation.subtitle: An online call on Google Meet. Pick a time that suits you — the doctor confirms it in your dashboard.
consultation.signInTitle: Log in to book a consultation
consultation.signInBody: Consultations are booked on your account, so the confirmation and the call link reach your dashboard.
consultation.beforeMealNote: Questions about a particular diet or meals.
consultation.beforePlanNote: Talk the plan through before you start.
consultation.whenHint: Polish time. The doctor may suggest a different slot.
consultation.successBody: The doctor will confirm {when} and add a Google Meet link. You will see the confirmation and the link in your dashboard.
consultation.errorGeneric: That consultation could not be booked.
consultation.errorSignedOut: Your session has expired — please log in again.
consultation.blikTitle: Pay by BLIK to a phone number
consultation.blikReferenceHint: Use this title so we can match the payment to your consultation. You will see the payment status in your dashboard.
consultation.blikPending: We will send the BLIK payment details shortly.
consultation.blikSteps: In your bank's app choose “BLIK phone transfer”, enter the number and amount below, and put the code below in the transfer title.

home.subtitle: Fresh meals delivered to your door. Ketogenic, gluten-free and allergy-safe — built from your own profile and a consultation with Dr Abdelrahman.

value.body: We start from your profile — weight, height and how you train — not from a box off a shelf.

a.title: Profile before purchase
a.body: Weight, height, body composition and physical activity. The diet is built once we know who it is for.

b.title: Delivered to your door
b.body: Pick your days on the calendar. On a longer plan the delivery is on us.

c.title: A dietitian in the loop
c.body: A consultation with Dr Abdelrahman before a meal and before a plan — optional, 100 PLN a session.

one.title: Create an account
one.body: Login is required to go any further.

two.title: Complete your profile
two.body: Weight, height, activity and four photos — front, back and both sides.

three.title: Pick a diet and days
three.body: One-time, or on the calendar with a five-meal minimum.

four.title: Take the delivery
four.body: Cash on delivery. Track how it is going in your dashboard.

pricing.body: A one-time order with shipping on you, or the calendar — and then shipping is on us.

ctaBand.body: Create an account, complete your profile and pick your first week.

intake.title: Your profile
intake.subtitle: Before we build your diet we need a few things about you. Without a complete profile an order is refused.
intake.bodyCompositionHint: If you know your body fat percentage or muscle mass, add it. This field is not required.
intake.errNoneWithSport: "No sport" cannot be combined with a sport — untick one of the two.
intake.errLoad: Could not load your profile. Check that you are signed in.
intake.photosIntro: Four body photos: front, back and both sides. The dietitian looks at them before building your plan.
intake.saveFirst: Save your measurements first — photos attach to a saved profile.
intake.completeYes: Profile complete — you can place an order.
intake.completeNo: Profile not complete yet — an order would be refused.
